This is tile-wide lighting drift, not just individual stone highlights.
Evidence: critic-r17E-2-repeat-cobble-small.png and critic-r17E-2-cobble-small-vertical-8x.png. The strongest reset is at y=48 and y=96 in the native 3x3 field.
